title_en: Haikou Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. — fine imposed for forging material evidence to obstruct court proceedings
keywords_en: civil; dispute over sale contract; first instance; basic people's court; Hainan Province; legal person; Civil Procedure Law; forged evidence; obstruction of litigation; supporting the plaintiff; motor vehicle sale; dispute over outstanding payment; important evidence hindering the court in hearing the case
full_text_en:
Haikou Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. — Penalty for Forging Important Evidence to Obstruct Court Proceedings

Party Subject to Fine: Haikou Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd., Hainan Province.

Legal Representative: Liu Xiaonan, Manager.

On November 2, 1991, the party subject to fine, Haikou Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd."), through the introduction of Wu Yuming, purchased a "Huaxi" brand medium-sized touring car from Chen Dongpo and Zhou Yuping for a price of RMB 18,000. On the same day, Chen Dongpo and Zhou Yuping issued a vehicle transfer certificate to Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. issued to Chen Dongpo and Zhou Yuping a receipt for the vehicle and an IOU for the unpaid vehicle price. The parties also orally agreed that Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. would pay the full vehicle price in the near future. Thereafter, Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. paid only RMB 3,900 to Chen Dongpo and Zhou Yuping, and delayed payment of the remaining balance of RMB 14,100. For this reason, Chen Dongpo and Zhou Yuping filed a lawsuit with the Xiuying District People's Court of Haikou City, Hainan Province.

Haikou Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. argued in its defense: On the day of the vehicle transaction, November 2, 1991, because Chen Dongpo and Zhou Yuping did not bring the vehicle insurance policy, after receiving the vehicle, we wrote a receipt for the vehicle and an IOU for the vehicle price to them, and the parties agreed that payment would be made after Chen Dongpo and Zhou Yuping submitted the insurance policy to us. On November 12 of the same year, Chen Dongpo came to our place, claiming that creditors were blocking his doorstep, and requested that we pay the vehicle price to him first, and then he would send the vehicle insurance policy later. At that time, we sympathized with his situation, handed over RMB 18,000 to Chen Dongpo on the spot, and asked Chen Dongpo to write a vehicle transfer certificate as proof. We forgot to retrieve the IOU for the vehicle price that we had issued on November 2. Therefore, the lawsuit by Chen Dongpo and Zhou Yuping demanding payment of the vehicle price is unfounded.

In the trial, the parties disagreed on whether the vehicle transfer certificate was issued on November 2 or November 12. To further clarify the facts and correctly adjudicate the case, the Xiuying District People's Court sent the vehicle transfer certificate, which was provided by Haikou Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. and purportedly issued by Chen Dongpo and Zhou Yuping on "November 12," to the Transportation Department of Hainan Province for technical authentication. The authentication conclusion was that the digit "1" in the date "November 12" had been added later. Thus, it was ascertained that Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. had fabricated false evidence that the full vehicle price had been paid in one lump sum on November 12, 1991, and only then had obtained the vehicle transfer certificate. Faced with the facts, Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. was speechless but refused to admit its error.

After rendering judgment in the case, the Xiuying District People's Court, in accordance with the provisions of Article 102, paragraph 1, subparagraph (1) and Article 104, paragraph 1, subparagraph (1) of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, and with the approval of the president of the court, issued a decision on a fine on January 13, 1992: to impose a fine of RMB 10,000 on Haikou Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. for its act of forging important evidence—the date on the vehicle transfer certificate—thereby obstructing the smooth progress of the litigation.

After the written decision on the fine was served, Haikou Nanxing Industrial Co., Ltd. did not apply for reconsideration, and the fine decision has been executed.
